name: Mariachi Band
spec: Violins, trumpet, vihuela, guitar and guitarrón, with several voices
alt: Six mariachi musicians in gray charro suits under aspens with yellow fall leaves, holding three violins, a guitarrón, a vihuela and a trumpet.
blurb: This mariachi plays the rancheras, boleros, huapangos and cumbias that so many families grew up with, from El Son de la Negra to Amor Eterno, in matching charro suits with violins, trumpet, vihuela, guitar and guitarrón. It's a perfect choice for a birthday serenade, a quinceañera, an anniversary or a wedding, and the band is happy to work with Spanish and English speaking families alike.
card_line: A full mariachi in matching charro suits, for birthday serenades, quinceañeras, anniversaries and weddings.
